question: The average of first 165 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first n even numbers is directly given by the formula (n + 1).

Here, the number of terms n = 165.

Average = 165 + 1 = 166.

**∴ The correct answer is 166.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of even terms (n) = 165

**Formula Used:**

Average of an Arithmetic Progression = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

Last term of the first n even numbers = 2n

 
• 
 
 
 First term
 2
 
 
 Last term
 330
 
 
 Average = (2 + 330) ÷ 2
 

 166
 
 Result: Average = 166

**Calculations:**

⇒ First even number (a) = 2

⇒ 165th even number (l) = 165 × 2 = 330

⇒ Average = (2 + 330) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 332 ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 166

**∴ The correct answer is 166.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of First n Odd Numbers

The average of the first n odd numbers is always equal to n.

Average of First n Natural Numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers is given by the formula (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Sum of First n Even Numbers

The sum of the first n even numbers is calculated as n(n + 1).
